title: Language Law Allowlist
description: The ratchet of the language law: how many English prose literals (the first argument of `Error(`, `console.*(` and `stdout|stderr.write(`) and how many lines that assume a language (an English fallback, the first offered language, a German-or-English ternary) each source file of the repo build library and of the process module still holds. A file may only lose them; a file that is not listed holds none; each ceiling is the total when the list was last cut and the totals may only shrink.
